name: computer_use__double_click
description:
Double-click at (x, y) or on an AX element identified by element_index + window_id.

AX path (element_index provided): performs `AXOpen` when the element advertises it (Finder items, openable list rows/cells); otherwise resolves the element's on-screen center and falls back to a pixel double-click there.

Pixel path (x, y provided): two down/up pairs ~80 ms apart at the given coordinates.

element_index.description: Element index from last get_window_state. Uses AX path.

session.description: Optional session id: declares/uses the agent cursor and per-session state for this run. The same id works over MCP, the CLI, or the raw socket, and follows the run across apps/windows. Omit to run cursor-less.

window_id.description: CGWindowID. Required when element_index is used.
